title: Infrastructure as Code and Automation
description: Provision and manage Azure infrastructure using Bicep, modules, parameters, and CI/CD automation.
longDescription: This module teaches infrastructure as code with Bicep. You will learn how to write Bicep templates, define parameters, variables, and outputs, create reusable modules, deploy infrastructure through CI/CD, and integrate Bicep with managed identities and private endpoints.
whatYouLearn: Deploy infrastructure with Azure CLI and CI/CD
Integrate Bicep with managed identities and private endpoints
